entity: Board of Vocational Rehabilitation - Division of Vocational Rehabilitation
role: State clearinghouse agency / draft EIS commenter
stance_basis: letter states no material effect on agency functions and no adverse environmental impact foreseen
summary: The Division of Vocational Rehabilitation reviewed the draft environmental statement for the Lincoln Highway project and concluded it would have no material effect on their functions and no adverse environmental impact. Their letter is brief and non-committal, neither supporting nor opposing the project, and they returned the documents due to storage constraints.
complaint_summary: The Division of Vocational Rehabilitation states it has little knowledge of the construction, foresees no adverse environmental effect and no material impact on its functions, and returns the documents due to storage constraints.

statement.text:
The Division of Vocational Rehabilitation has little, if any, knowledge relative to the construction referred to above. There is no way known to this office in which the proposed construction could adversely affect the environment. It is not foreseen that such a project could have any material effect on the functions of the Division of Vocational Rehabilitation.
I am returning the documents which you forwarded on the subject. We are a little short of storage space and it appears unlikely that we will have any further necessity to refer to them.
